name: Sonny's Car Wash
shortInfo: Sonny Car Wash is a car wash management technology company.
brief: This Connector enables streaming relevant Sonny Car Wash transactions data into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about: Get access to transactions report through this Sonny Car Wash connector. It enables streaming of relevant Sonny Car Wash data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.
availableData:
[Transactions](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/sonny-car-wash/pipelines/transactions.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve transactions' details from the Sonny Car wash account.
